A practical **North American hotel-conversion shortlist** usually includes the following collection and soft-brand options:

| Parent company | Commonly considered brands | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott** | **The Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio** | Luxury through upscale independent full-service and lifestyle hotels. Marriott identifies these as its principal collection brands for independent hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **LXR Hotels & Resorts, Curio Collection, Tapestry Collection, Outset Collection** | LXR for luxury; Curio for upper-upscale/lifestyle; Tapestry for upscale boutique; newly launched Outset for more flexible upscale and upper-midscale conversions. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt, JdV by Hyatt, Destination by Hyatt** | Unbound for upper-upscale/luxury landmark hotels; JdV for neighborhood-oriented boutique properties; Destination for resorts and destination hotels. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection**, plus **voco** as a closely related conversion option | Vignette is the primary luxury soft brand; voco is an upscale, conversion-led brand with flexible design requirements. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice** | **Ascend Hotel Collection, Radisson Individuals** | Ascend for upscale independent, boutique and historic hotels; Radisson Individuals for larger upscale/upper-upscale full-service properties. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/about-choice-hotels?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Registry Collection Hotels, Trademark Collection by Wyndham, Dolce Hotels and Resorts** | Registry for upper-upscale/luxury; Trademark for upper-midscale independent hotels; Dolce for resorts, conference hotels and distinctive full-service assets. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/convert-your-existing-hotel?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels** | **BW Premier Collection, BW Signature Collection**, and **WorldHotels Luxury, Elite, Crafted and Distinctive** | Broad coverage from midscale/upscale conversions through luxury independent hotels. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/content/developers/en_US/portfolio.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **MGallery Hotel Collection, Handwritten Collection** | Boutique and lifestyle conversions, particularly where Accor has meaningful international feeder demand; generally considered less frequently than Marriott, Hilton or Hyatt in many U.S. markets. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/-/media/Corporate/our-brands/PDF-for-pages/MGallery/MGallery_factsheet_EN_0222.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |

### Newer options to watch

- **Outset Collection by Hilton** — launched in October 2025 as a flexible upscale/upper-midscale conversion collection, initially focused heavily on the United States and Canada. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/launch-of-outset-collection-by-hilton?utm_source=openai))
- **Series by Marriott** — a newer midscale-to-upscale collection model designed primarily for regional hotel companies and portfolio conversions; available in the U.S. and Canada. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/seriesbymarriott?utm_source=openai))
- **Noted Collection by IHG** — launched in February 2026 for distinctive upscale-to-upper-upscale conversions, but initially focused on Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia, so it is not yet a core North American alternative. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2026/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-unveils-new-premium-collection-brand-noted-collection?utm_source=openai))

### Nontraditional affiliation alternatives

Owners seeking greater independence sometimes compare the chain soft brands against:

- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts** — an independent-hotel affiliation providing distribution, sales, marketing and the I Prefer loyalty program, but generally with less operating standardization than a major-chain franchise. ([join.preferredhotels.com](https://join.preferredhotels.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **The Leading Hotels of the World** — a selective luxury membership alternative, generally appropriate only for established, high-end independent hotels. ([lhw.com](https://www.lhw.com/corporate/fact-sheet?utm_source=openai))
- **Historic Hotels of America/Worldwide** — usually an overlay or marketing affiliation for qualifying historic properties rather than a complete replacement for a franchise system. ([preferredhotels.com](https://preferredhotels.com/collections?utm_source=openai))

### Typical first-round shortlist by asset

- **Luxury landmark or resort:** Luxury Collection, LXR, Unbound, Vignette, Registry, WorldHotels Luxury, Preferred or LHW.
- **Upper-upscale independent full-service:** Autograph, Curio, Unbound, Destination, Radisson Individuals, WorldHotels Elite/Crafted.
- **Upscale boutique:** Tribute, Tapestry, JdV, Outset, Ascend, BW Premier Collection or Handwritten.
- **Upper-midscale conversion:** Outset, Trademark, BW Signature Collection or Series by Marriott.
- **Conference or destination resort:** Destination by Hyatt, Dolce, Autograph, Curio, Unbound or Registry.

The final comparison normally turns less on the brand name and more on **required renovation/PIP, total fee load, loyalty and direct-booking contribution, market availability, area protection, F&B requirements, management flexibility and termination or change-of-control provisions**. A brand that produces slightly lower ADR but requires materially less conversion capital can be the better owner return.
